title: Flight Delay RAG - self-hosted vLLM (optional)
description: ONLY for the optional self-hosted profile (deploy/k8s/30-vllm.yaml, or the commented vllm job in deploy/prometheus/prometheus.yml). These series come from vLLM's own /metrics endpoint. The adopted production generator is HOSTED (Groq), which exposes none of them, so this dashboard is NOT provisioned by default - Grafana loads only deploy/grafana/dashboards/. Import it by hand (Dashboards -> Import -> upload this file) when vLLM is actually running and being scraped.

options.content: These panels are **blank unless a vLLM server is being scraped**. Blank does not mean idle: a hosted provider has no KV cache to report. Enable the `vllm` scrape job in `deploy/prometheus/prometheus.yml` (local) or the `vllm` ServiceMonitor in `deploy/k8s/40-monitoring.yaml` (cluster) first.

panels.title: KV cache utilisation vs waiting queue
panels.description: The saturation knee: once gpu_cache_usage_perc pins near 1.0, num_requests_waiting grows and latency follows. Measured locally by scripts/bench_kv_cache.py.

panels.title: Time to first token (p95)
panels.description: Prefill latency. Rises with context length, which is why the evidence budget is capped rather than 'as much as fits'.
